escalations.title: handlebars JavaScript Injection RCE
escalations.reason: RCE via template injection — TheGuardians must assess whether any template renders user-controlled input

escalations.title: proxy-addr IP Spoofing / Trust Subnet Bypass
escalations.reason: Authentication bypass risk — IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses bypass Express trust-proxy checks; TheGuardians must assess trust proxy configuration
escalations.fix: Upgrade express to 5.x to pull proxy-addr >=2.0.8

escalations.title: protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution
escalations.reason: RCE via malformed .proto messages — TheGuardians must assess whether orchestrator accepts external protobuf data

p1_findings.title: Route handlers bypass the service layer
p1_findings.detail: 20 direct store calls across 3 route modules. CLAUDE.md non-negotiable: 'No direct DB calls from route handlers — use the service layer.' In-memory store is the DB-equivalent.
p1_findings.recommendation: Create WorkItemService; refactor 3 route modules to parse → call service → respond. Follow dashboard.ts → services/dashboard.ts pattern.
p1_findings.cross_ref: Shares root cause with QO-002: both are architecture/process discipline gaps

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer validates only 13 of 111 FRs — CI gate is a false positive
p1_findings.detail: tools/traceability-enforcer.py:56 uses os.path.getmtime to auto-pick most-recently-modified requirements file. Currently picks Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md (13 FRs → PASS). Never checks dev-workflow-platform.md (69 FRs, 0% coverage) or tiered-merge-pipeline.md (13 FRs, 0% coverage).
p1_findings.recommendation: Add --all-plans mode iterating all Plans/*/requirements.md. Mark inactive plans as Status: ARCHIVED. Update CLAUDE.md gate command.

p1_findings.title: vitest direct dependency RCE (CVSS 9.8)
p1_findings.detail: When Vitest UI server is listening, arbitrary files can be read and executed without authentication. Direct dependency.
p1_findings.fix: npm update vitest to >=3.2.6 or >=4.1.11 or >=5.1.0 in Source/Frontend. Also resolves DEP-005.

p1_findings.title: proxy-addr IP Spoofing — trust bypass (CVSS 9.1)
p1_findings.fix: Upgrade express to 5.x to pull proxy-addr >=2.0.8

p1_findings.title: tinypool Prototype Pollution RCE (via vitest)
p1_findings.detail: Transitive via vitest. Malicious worker options trigger prototype pollution leading to RCE during test execution.

p1_findings.title: Portal/Backend: 61 vulnerabilities including 4 critical
p1_findings.detail: 61 vulnerabilities (4 critical, 11 high, 46 moderate). Portal has 578 transitive dependencies. Lateral movement risk if portal server is reachable.
p1_findings.fix: Determine in-scope vs dev-only. If in-scope: update all @opentelemetry/* packages. If dev-only: document isolation boundary.

p2_findings.title: dev-workflow-platform.md FR-001 to FR-069 describe an application not built in Source/
p2_findings.detail: 69 FRs define SQLite, FeatureRequest, BugReport, Ticket entities — none exist in Source/. Source/ implements WorkItem-based in-memory engine. 0% coverage on these 69 FRs.
p2_findings.recommendation: Archive or update spec to reflect what Source/ actually builds. Create authoritative spec for WorkItem engine.

p2_findings.title: tiered-merge-pipeline.md 13 FRs have zero implementation — status unknown
p2_findings.detail: FR-TMP-001 through FR-TMP-010 and FR-1 to FR-3 define risk classification, E2E test generation, Playwright, auto-PR, AI PR review, auto-merge. No implementation in Source/. Status unknown.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add Status: PLANNED | DEFERRED | ABANDONED header. Archive if abandoned.

p2_findings.title: dependency-linking plan references non-existent portal/ project paths
p2_findings.detail: All requirements reference portal/Backend, portal/Frontend, portal/Shared/ — paths not in this repo. Causes 7 false enforcer failures (FR-0002, FR-0003, FR-0004, FR-0005, FR-0007, FR-070, FR-085).
p2_findings.recommendation: Add Status: ARCHIVED (applied to portal/) header to prevent misleading enforcer failures.

p2_findings.title: body-parser request size limit bypass enabling DoS
form-data ReDoS and path traversal
p2_findings.fix: Update form-data to latest via npm update

p2_findings.title: React Router open redirect via protocol-relative URL

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable react-hooks/exhaustive-deps in 2 files without explanation
p3_findings.recommendation: Add inline comment explaining intentional dep omission. If dep should be included, add it and test.

p3_findings.title: Hardcoded localhost:4200 fallback in DebugPortalPage iframe
p3_findings.recommendation: Make VITE_PORTAL_URL required at build time, or show a disabled placeholder when URL is a localhost default in non-local env. Document in .env.example.

p3_findings.title: 67 moderate CVEs (grouped)
p3_findings.detail: Categories: brace-expansion ReDoS, browserslist DoS, js-yaml unsafe deserialize, nanoid weak randomness (CVSS 5.3), ws DoS, postcss CSS parse DoS, esbuild minification, baseline-browser-mapping DoS. All transitive.

p4_findings.title: 10 low-severity CVEs (grouped)
p4_findings.detail: Low-risk CVEs across transitive dependencies. No immediate action required.

grading.rationale: F is assigned because: (1) DEP-003 is an exploitable authentication bypass (proxy-addr IP spoofing CVSS 9.1) — config.grading F trigger: 'exploitable auth bypass'; (2) 12 critical CVEs including 3 at CVSS 9.8 — config.grading F trigger: 'critical domain failure'; (3) 8 total P1 findings exceeds D threshold; (4) 26% spec coverage is below the 40% minimum for grade C.

thresholds.F: exploitable auth bypass + critical domain failure
